F1 test, registered direction: LONG rising-ATS / SHORT shrinking-ATS (retail swarm) centered-rank book, B=90, has net IS Sharpe > 0 @1x for some (W,h) in the pre-registered 3x3 grid, with plateau structure at 1-4wk horizons.
